The '''Plains of Dust''' were desert flatlands on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Plains of Dust is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
